stories.mockHeadline: "Not to my knowledge" clocks in for another full shift on the homepage
stories.mockDek: The Gateway Pundit has the question, the shrug, and a VIDEO tag. The rumor stays in the chyron. The answer, such as it is, gets a parking spot.
stories.originalTitle: (VIDEO) Trump Responds to Ilhan Omar Saying “Not to My Knowledge” When Asked if She Married Her Brother

stories.mockHeadline: Someone said "liar" on a stage, so the homepage added explosives
stories.mockDek: The Gateway Pundit files a debate insult as ordnance, plus a play button. BOOM is doing the reporting.
stories.originalTitle: BOOM! Mike Rogers Calls Abdul El-Sayed a LIAR to His Face During Debate ‘This is a Pattern’ (VIDEO)

stories.mockHeadline: Kansas candidates spend a debate pretending they have never met their parties
stories.mockDek: Fox News calls it fiery. It is two people backing away from a group photo while control of the Senate gets a mention.
stories.originalTitle: Kansas Senate rivals distance themselves from party leaders in fiery debate

stories.mockHeadline: Michigan debate shrinks to a panel: America, or a vague menace overseas
stories.mockDek: Breitbart heard a loyalty quiz and took dictation. "Running for Senate" did not fit on the button.
stories.originalTitle: Mike Rogers Presses El-Sayed in Final Michigan Senate Debate: ‘Are You for America' or 'Terrorist Groups Overseas?’

stories.mockHeadline: A heckler gets reviewed for looks, then a punch gets a highlight reel
stories.mockDek: The Gateway Pundit covers a rally scuffle like a boxing undercard, complete with a note on the face. The joke is the caption.
stories.originalTitle: “Really Unattractive” Leftist Gets Clocked After Screaming at Trump at Rally – Trump Calls Supporter “Evander ‘The Real Deal’ Holyfield” – CROWD ROARS! (VIDEO)

stories.mockHeadline: The raid is a moving box. The homepage is still on the old question.
stories.mockDek: The Washington Examiner reports an emptied apartment and death threats. The rest of the building has not changed the subject.
stories.originalTitle: Ilhan Omar vacating DC apartment after federal raid, citing death threats

stories.mockHeadline: Candidate calls a voting bill suppression. The desk faints on time.
stories.mockDek: Breitbart prints the flinch as the story. The machinery of the bill can wait until the outrage is plated.
stories.originalTitle: Michigan Debate: El-Sayed Claims SAVE America Act ‘About Voter Suppression’

stories.mockHeadline: A firing vow, a fraud ghost, and a Democrat who is not in the room
stories.mockDek: Fox News needs a clash, so Minnesota supplies one. The vow is doing most of the work.
stories.originalTitle: Mass firings vow sparks clash with Klobuchar over Walz fraud legacy

stories.mockHeadline: Fox scoreboard: Trump wins a Michigan debate he did not attend
stories.mockDek: The package says he dominates the attacks. The two candidates who were on the stage get a split mention.
stories.originalTitle: Trump dominates El-Sayed's attacks against Rogers, but GOP rival offers unexpected policy split

stories.mockHeadline: Michigan is declared a needle. Experts are asked if it still moves.
stories.mockDek: The Washington Examiner runs the October classic: the race is finished, and also about to break open.
stories.originalTitle: Is it too late to move the midterm needle in Michigan?

stories.mockHeadline: France is in the streets. The stake, on this desk, is the NFL pregame.
stories.mockDek: PJ Media looks at unrest and finds a Sunday broadcast. The camera truck's travel plans become the American angle.
stories.originalTitle: Riots Across France Scare Off American Media Covering Sunday’s NFL Game in Paris

stories.mockHeadline: The rally brings the line. The headline brings the can of gasoline.
stories.mockDek: The Washington Examiner gives "burn it all down" a full shift in South Carolina. The Senate candidate being boosted shows up, eventually.
stories.originalTitle: Trump warns Democrats ‘want to burn it all down’ in South Carolina pitch

stories.mockHeadline: Forty defendants, 42 million dollars, and a round number's worth of certainty
stories.mockDek: One America News stacks accusations and a dollar figure in the same breath. Court is a later episode.
stories.originalTitle: Trump admin. announces enforcement actions against over 40 defendants accused of nearly $42M in SNAP fraud

stories.mockHeadline: The Post scratches its head so a shrug can still lead the page
stories.mockDek: "Head-scratching" is what you write when the quote dodges and the homepage still needs a temperature. The New York Post supplies the hand to the temple.
stories.originalTitle: Ilhan Omar gives head-scratching response when asked if she’s related to ex-husband in first interview since DC raid

stories.mockHeadline: A cybercrime crackdown is announced at a table, where computers go to be discussed
stories.mockDek: Breitbart has the president, a roundtable, and a crackdown. The people being cracked down on, being online, did not attend.
stories.originalTitle: Trump at Roundtable Details Administration's Crackdown on Cybercrime

stories.mockHeadline: A final debate, graded as a loyalty check
stories.mockDek: The Washington Times hears a Senate race and files a patriotism quiz. Policy made a brief appearance and was asked to wait outside.
stories.originalTitle: Rogers questions El-Sayed's loyalty to the U.S. in their final debate showdown

stories.mockHeadline: A show announces the dirt is piling, and declines to say which dirt
stories.mockDek: The Blaze has a stack and a type treatment. Viewers are invited to imagine the rest.
stories.originalTitle: The Abdul El-Sayed dirt keeps PILING UP

stories.mockHeadline: A comedy scolding gets an age joke in the headline, which saves you the clip
stories.mockDek: The Blaze covers one comic chiding another and labels the whole thing a senior moment. The bit is now optional.
stories.originalTitle: SENIOR MOMENT: Veteran 'SNL' player breaks ranks to scold Shane Gillis for jokes

stories.mockHeadline: The recap is a stopwatch and the word "lies"
stories.mockDek: The Daily Wire names a winner before a fact-check graphic could finish loading. Rapid-fire is a format. It is not a finding.
stories.originalTitle: Mike Rogers Breaks Down El-Sayed With Rapid-Fire List Of Lies At Debate

stories.mockHeadline: A senator's remarks get a CIA costume and the verb "destroy"
stories.mockDek: The Federalist hands out a spook title and a threat level. A quote can stretch. It cannot stretch into a covert operation without a wardrobe budget.
stories.originalTitle: CIA Spook Slotkin Doubles Down On Threat To Destroy Young Conservative Staffers

stories.mockHeadline: One alleged voter, four elections, a headline that already reached a verdict
stories.mockDek: The Federalist prints an attorney general's claim as weather. Any hearing is a later episode.
stories.originalTitle: Indiana AG: Illegal Alien Voted In 4 Federal Elections

stories.mockHeadline: A lawsuit over election power picks up the verb "seizing" for free
stories.mockDek: Newsmax has Democrats, a filing, and a president the headline has already caught in the act.
stories.originalTitle: Dems Sue to Stop Trump From Seizing States' Election Powers

stories.mockHeadline: National Review opens a reminder service for a grudge already on file
stories.mockDek: Vivek Ramaswamy has once again reminded the magazine why it keeps a standing column about him. The headline is the piece.
stories.originalTitle: Vivek Ramaswamy Reminds Voters Why They Never Liked Him

stories.mockHeadline: New Jersey's voter list gets a subpoena and a number with a K in it
stories.mockDek: Just the News, the wire Real America's Voice sends people to read, has the committees, the state, and tens of thousands of something. Whether the matches hold is scheduled for later.
stories.originalTitle: U.S. House committees subpoena New Jersey in probe of foreigners on voter rolls

stories.mockHeadline: Socialists fail to laugh. Townhall treats that as a finding.
stories.mockDek: Larry David wrote something. A faction did not chuckle. Townhall files the silence as a diagnostic test.
stories.originalTitle: Democratic Socialists Are Not Amused by Larry David's Latest Op-Ed. It's Not Hard to See Why

stories.mockHeadline: A cabinet official is located on a very large boat. The network hits caps lock.
stories.mockDek: Real America's Voice found Pete Hegseth aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln and printed EXCLUSIVE the way other desks print a leak. The ship was not in hiding.
stories.originalTitle: EXCLUSIVE: HEGSETH SPEAKS OUT FROM ABOARD THE USS ABRAHAM LINCOLN
